mentions.name: FDrive
mentions.description: A Dropbox-like app that works with FTP and every other storage protocol, including gateways to access Dropbox over FTP, SFTP, and S3. It ships as a desktop client (fdrive) and a web client (filestash).
mentions.source_excerpt:
A Drobpox like app that works with FTP and every other storage protocol along gateways to access your Dropbox over FTP, SFTP, S3:

- the desktop client: https://github.com/mickael-kerjean/fdrive

- the web client: https://github.com/mickael-kerjean/filestash
mentions.author: mickael-kerjean

mentions.name: fdrive
mentions.description: A Dropbox-like client that works with every storage protocol, supporting S3, SFTP, SMB, NFS, Azure Blob, IPFS, and more for unified file access.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a Dropbox like client that work with every protocol there is: S3, SFTP, SMB, NFS, Azure Blob, IPFS, ...
mentions.author: mickael-kerjean
